name: Monke Monke
summary:
Monke Monke is a fan game that’s all about fun, creativity, and uniqueness. It features a variety of exciting maps to explore, along with cool and playful mechanics. Rather than focusing on high-end graphics or perfect layouts, Monke Monke is designed to bring people together encouraging players to have fun and enjoy the experience with friends.
